hotspots.title: November 2002
hotspots.body: The second film followed its predecessor by just a year, released in mid-November 2002 with Chris Columbus directing again and Steve Kloves returning as screenwriter.

hotspots.title: Cars of a certain age
hotspots.body: The flying car is a small blue British saloon of the early 1960s. Several real examples were used during filming, and some were reportedly wrecked in the sequence with the furious tree.

hotspots.title: The longest of the eight
hotspots.body: At around 161 minutes, this is the longest film in the series, even though its book is one of the shorter ones.

hotspots.title: A digital co-star
hotspots.body: The anxious house-elf was one of the first major fully computer-generated characters in a live-action family film, animated to share scenes and eye-lines with the young cast.

hotspots.title: A celebrity professor
hotspots.body: Kenneth Branagh played the vain, smiling Defence teacher whose fame rests on other people's deeds, giving the film much of its comedy.

hotspots.title: A farewell
hotspots.body: This was Richard Harris's second and last film as the headmaster. He died in October 2002, a few weeks before its release, and the role was recast for the third film.

hotspots.title: Williams, adapted
hotspots.body: John Williams composed new themes, including a creeping motif for the hidden chamber. With his schedule full, William Ross adapted and conducted much of the score.

hotspots.title: Words on the wall
hotspots.body: A warning daubed on a corridor wall, water spreading across the flagstones, and a cat frozen stiff: the school year turns from adventure to mystery in a single night.

hotspots.title: A creature built big
hotspots.body: For close shots of the great serpent, the crew built a large animatronic head; the full creature in motion was finished digitally.

hotspots.title: A diary that writes back
hotspots.body: An empty diary answers when you write in it. The film stages the conversation with ink that soaks in and reappears as a reply.

hotspots.title: Over real countryside
hotspots.body: Aerial photography of rural English landscape gave the flight its sense of scale, with the car itself added in compositing.

collectibles.name: A sock
collectibles.note: Grey, and a long way from its pair.

collectibles.name: A spider's thread
collectibles.note: Glinting, and leading somewhere you would rather not go.
